scope: fifth external corpus (11 third-party CHANGELOGs); defects 16 and 17

corpus.theOneThatFails: omdsh-dev__DSH-better-sidebar/CHANGELOG_EN.md — re-lists an unpublished alpha after a newer stable release, outside the <details> block that its own Chinese translation wraps it in. A genuine inconsistency between the two translations, not a detector problem.
corpus.callerError: a first pass fed src/changelog.ts through the Markdown checker and got version-missing — that is a caller mistake, not a defect

defects.bug: ordering was computed over the whole file, including a collapsed <details> history appendix where an unpublished alpha is re-listed with a note that it was folded into the previous release
defects.fix: mask <details>...</details> before computing order; line numbers preserved
defects.verification: the same repo's English changelog keeps the entry outside any <details> and is still reported

defects.bug: the heading pattern starts at the newline BEFORE a heading and the line was counted up to that newline, so every ordering finding pointed at the blank line above the heading it complained about
defects.impact: a reader clicking the reported line lands on an empty line — the finding was right and the pointer was wrong
defects.fix: skip past the leading newline when counting
defects.foundBy: a third-party changelog where the reported line 338 was empty and the heading was on 339

npxVerified: same entry inline -> order error at line 7, which is the heading
selfInflicted: the commit for this change was blocked by my own commit-msg hook for a 78-char subject, and the push loop reported success on a no-op — the same false-green pattern recorded twice before. Shortened the subject and pushed properly.
